integrity: Proof and reproducible finite checks are included; numerical experiments are not an infinite proof. Historical priority is provisional. No external independent verification is claimed.
object: Standard Euclidean incidence-vector realization of ordinary Catalan matroid base polytopes
scientific_limitations: The theorem addresses ordinary Catalan matroids rather than general lattice path matroids.
The inradius is intrinsic to the canonical incidence-vector embedding; arbitrary affine equivalence does not preserve it.
No incenter-face enumeration or generalization to (a,b)-Catalan matroids is claimed.
Historical priority is subject to independent literature verification.
title: A dimension-stable inball and codimension-four incenter family for Catalan matroid polytopes
